title: Copy a range of 40-byte records
summary: Copies each record as ten sequential 32-bit words and returns the advanced destination; a null destination skips the current record before advancing.
test_description: Compare original and recovered routines for empty, single and multiple records, identical and overlapping ranges in both directions, including a one-word displacement, and null destination for zero or one record. Check returned pointers, all record words including untouched surrounding records, and FS head restoration after each original call.
known_limits: The original requires the end address to be reachable by repeated 40-byte increments; invalid ranges and inaccessible memory are outside the tests.
A null destination with more than one record advances to address 40 and normally faults; fault behavior is not tested.
The original uses ECX and EDX for its first two arguments and caller stack cleanup for the third; the portable recovery exposes a normal C++ function.
